import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { type KrdsLocale } from '../../providers/index.js';
import { type CalendarTranslations } from '../calendar/index.js';
import { type DateModeProps } from '../calendar/model.js';
export interface DateInputTranslations {
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    formatHint: string;
    openCalendar: string;
    calendarTitle: string;
    requiredError: string;
    formatError: string;
    incompleteRangeError: string;
    orderError: string;
    minError: string;
    maxError: string;
}
export type DateInputProps = DateModeProps & {
    label: ReactNode;
    id?: string;
    name?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    form?: string;
    autoComplete?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
    locale?: KrdsLocale;
    translations?: Partial<DateInputTranslations>;
    calendarTranslations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    withCalendar?: boolean;
    hint?: ReactNode;
    error?: ReactNode;
    invalid?: boolean;
};
export declare function DateInput(props: DateInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
